en: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.
Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?
I need a ride, Dungar!  I have important supplies to deliver!
Dinner has arrived!
I have misplaced my Zandalar Augur's Bracers and require another pair.
%s looks relieved.
Hold! I sense an evil presence... Undead!
I cannot in good conscience spend time training novices while our allies, the undead, are suffering so terribly. Please speak with Kray over there instead; he can help you for now.
I bet you're sorry now, aren't you $n!?!
Nice work! I'll set off the charges to prevent any more troggs from making it to the surface.
Begone foul creatures!  Go back to the void your master shaped you from!
|cffffff00Eastwall Tower has been taken by the Alliance!|r
There is not a better tracker in these lands than Drayl.  He can be found on the Hunter Rise.
What are Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets and how do I get them?
I should talk to Dewey about some sort of notation system to these keep books better organized.
The Dun Baldar South Bunker is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Horde will destroy it!
The corruption of the fel has not left any of the creatures of Felwood untouched, $n. Please, be on your guard.
Can you tell me where Brine is?
%s summons a Blackhand Veteran to his aid!
Will these unrelenting Scourge attacks never end?
Now you die!
Jungle Fever
I'd be wasting both your gold and my time if I were to teach you how to pilot a Mechanostrider, $c.  You're just too large!
The pain is unbearable!
I woke up in a bed in Northshire three weeks later. Don't remember a damn thing.
No hello for your old friend, Narain? Who were you expecting???
The troggs are retaking the Irondeep Mine!

First Aid is always a nice skill to have.  Many a time during battle has it saved my hide.  Visit Spiritual Healing on the Spirit Rise.  Pand Stonebinder can teach you all you need to know to save your hide as well.
Yes. $n. I have located the Forest Lord. We must redouble our efforts! More crystals are needed!
Your bondage is at an end, Doom'rel.  I challenge you!
That $n wants me dead!  Help!
You've already learned everything I can teach you, $n. Talk to the night elf Lilyssia Nightbreeze in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind if you want to continue your studies. I hear she's a good teacher.

Throm'ka, $c. All of the war materiel is in final preparation and being sent to Silithus. It should arrive over the course of the next $2113w days. With the equipment readied, and our forces arrayed, all we will be waiting for is someone to ring the gong on the Scarab Dais, which should open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj and start the war.$B$BLok'tar Ogar!
Who sent you here? You're not ready for my instruction yet! You'll be told when you're ready.
Prepare yourself, $n.  I go to open the rift...
I shall scour the earth for this Earthshaper. What of the essence?
%s listens as $n tells him of $ghis:her; adventures in the Badlands.
Grimclaw?! Easy there, my friend... where is your master Volcor?
Arrrgh!
Three cheers for $n -- Admiral o' the Bloodsail Bucaneer Navy!
Blacksmithing
Us need check to see if our Brain... Brain... Brain Hacker sold at auction.  You find mailbox next to inn on upper ring of Trade Quarter.
Greetings.  If you are here for leather goods, then you will find my wares well crafted.
Start making sense, dwarf. I don't want to have anything to do with your cracker, your pappy, or any sort of 'discreditin.'
Stop!  Foolish $c, we cannot let you summon the creature Myzrael!
Shadowfang Keep is in southern Silverpine just north of Pyrewood Village.
Well done. You have now earned tailoring's highest honor. Go forth, and do terrible things with this knowledge!
I won't let you down!
You have no business with me, little one.
Defias activity reported on the costal horizon.  All clear on Sentinel Hill.
I've heard about enough a' yer snivelin'! Shut yer flytrap before I shut it for ye'!
Good luck out there, $n.
Now that the Frostwolf general is defeated, we can spare some troops to guard the entrance to Winterax Hold.$B$BBut stay vigilant!  We must always be on the lookout for Horde interlopers..

Scourge activity in the Plaguelands has increased ten-fold. We are receiving reports of Scourge attacks from as far away as Kalimdor! Now how do you suppose this has happened? How have the wretched undead done that which was previously thought impossible? Is nowhere safe?
Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $n!
Embrace the end!
